blocks.title: Free oscillations (azad jhoolna)
blocks.text: Jism free vibrations karta hai agar woh kisi bairooni quwwat ki mudakhlat ke baghair apni qudrati frequency par jhoole.

Maslan apni darmiyani jagah se thora hataya gaya simple pendulum apni qudrati frequency par azadi se jhoolta hai, jo sirf us ki lambai par munhasir hai (Fig 14.12, pendulum A se B se C tak jhoolta hai). Free oscillations mein, mazahmati quwwat na ho to, jism ki kul tawanai aur is liye amplitude constant rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Nuqta O se latka simple pendulum. Bob ko intihai jagah A, darmiyani jagah B aur doosri intihai jagah C par dikhaya gaya hai, aur nuqtedaar kaman (arc) aur teer use A se B se C aur wapas jhoolte dikhate hain. Panel kehta hai ke yeh apni qudrati frequency f = (1/2 pi) square root of (g/l) par jhoolta hai, koi bairooni quwwat nahi, aur rukawat na ho to is ka amplitude qaim rehta hai.
blocks.caption: Simple pendulum ki free oscillation (Fig 14.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hataa kar chhorne ke baad pendulum par gravity aur dhaage ke siwa bahar se kuch asar nahi karta, is liye woh apni qudrati frequency par jhoolta hai jo (diye gaye g ke liye) sirf us ki lambai par munhasir hai. Hawa ki rukawat na ho to us ki energy, aur is liye amplitude, nahi badalta.

blocks.title: Forced oscillations (jabri jhoolna)
blocks.text: Agar azadi se jhoolte nizam par bairooni dauri quwwat amal kare to forced vibrations hoti hain, maslan jab jhoole ko bar bar dhakka diya jaye (Fig 14.13).
Bhari machinery se karkhane ke farsh ki thartharahat forced vibrations ki misal hai. Aik aur misal taar wale saazon ke lakri ke takhton ki unchi awaz hai, jinhein taarein thartharati hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: apne dhaanche par jhoola, apni jhool ke dono siron par dikhaya gaya, aur laal teer aik sire par diye gaye dhakke F ko dikhata hai. Daen: waqt ke saath jhoole ke hataao (displacement) ka graph, aik yaksaan lehar, aur har chakkar ke neeche chhoti laal patti jo har jhool par aik dhakka dikhati hai.
blocks.caption: Forced oscillation: har jhool par aik dhakka khata jhoola (Fig 14.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Waqfe waqfe se lagne wali bairooni quwwat (driving force) jhoole ko chalaye rakhti hai; phir jhoola dhakkon ki frequency, yaani driving frequency par thartharata hai, zaruri nahi ke apni qudrati (natural) frequency par.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Kitab guitar ki taar, bajti ghanti, atomic oscillations, pul ki thartharahat aur imarat ke jhoolne ko free oscillations ki misalein batati hai.

blocks.prompt: Jhoole par bachcha jise aik dafa dhakka de kar chhor diya jaye free ya forced oscillation karta hai? Agar har chakkar mein dhakka diya jaye?
blocks.explanation: Aik dafa dhakka de kar chhorna: free oscillation (jhoole ki qudrati frequency par, ahista ahista khatam). Har chakkar mein dhakka: forced oscillation.

items: Free oscillation: qudrati frequency par, bairooni quwwat nahi.
Forced oscillation: bairooni dauri quwwat se chalayi gayi (dhakke wala jhoola, karkhane ka farsh).
